title: Apex Trackdays: Buttonwillow Open Lapping
description: Open lapping day on the CW13 configuration. Run groups by experience — novice, intermediate, advanced. Tech inspection at 7:00, first session out at 7:30. Bring a helmet (SA2015+) and a full tank.

title: Big Willow Time Attack Series Rd. 4
description: Round 4 of the season. Street, Modified, and Unlimited classes. Points on the line for the November final. Spectators welcome, paddock parking included with entry.

title: Sunrise Cars & Coffee — PCH Overlook
description: Casual meet at the PCH overlook lot in Dana Point. No entry fee, no judging — just good cars and better coffee from the truck that shows up every week. Roll in quiet, we're in a neighborhood.

title: Chuckwalla Novice Track Day
description: Instructor-led sessions for first-timers and low-seat-time drivers. Classroom walkthrough at 7:30, on-track pairing with a coach for your first two sessions. Beginner friendly, low-pressure pace.

title: SoCal Autocross — OCFairgrounds Lot D
description: Weekly autocross in the fairgrounds lot. Course walk at 7:00, first heat at 8:00. Two runs per driver per session, three sessions. All skill levels, helmets loaned at registration.

title: Willow Springs Sunset Lapping
description: Half-day afternoon session that runs through golden hour into dusk with track lighting on the front straight. Cooler temps, better grip, incredible photos.

title: Buttonwillow Grassroots Meet
description: Post-work meet at the Bakersfield In-N-Out lot before the weekend's track day. Trade notes on setups, swap ride shares for tech inspection, no cover charge.

title: Chuckwalla Time Attack Shootout
description: One-day shootout format — three qualifying sessions, top 10 per class advance to a final shootout session for fastest lap. Full course configuration.

title: Late Night Meet — Signal Hill Overlook
description: Casual evening meet with a view over the harbor. Bring a chair. Keep exhausts civil, we've had noise complaints before.

title: Willow Springs Novice + Intermediate Day
description: Two run groups only — Novice and Intermediate — for a calmer, more spacious track day. Instructors available for ride-alongs on request.
